title: SemGeo-Gen: Unsupervised Generation of Approximate Cross-Instance Semantic-Geometric Correspondences
abstract: arXiv:2610.32663v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce SemGeo-Gen, an unsupervised method for generating approximate cross-instance semantic-geometric supervision from weakly aligned 3D object collections. Our goal is not to recover exact point-level correspondences, which are often ambiguous across different instances and would require expensive, impractical manual supervision at scale. Instead, we automatically produce approximate correspondences that are semantically meaningful, geometrically consistent, and diverse enough to train modern correspondence models. Given only coarse category-level rotation alignment, SemGeo-Gen lifts multi-view DINOv2 features to 3D, aligns object instances using continuous piecewise-affine registration, and prunes candidate matches using semantic consistency. The resulting 3D correspondences can be projected into rendered views, yielding scalable 3D-3D, 3D-2D, and 2D-2D supervision without manual annotation. We validate the generated correspon

translated_title: SemGeo-Gen：无监督生成跨实例的近似语义-几何对应关系
translated_abstract: 我们提出了SemGeo-Gen，这是一种无监督方法，用于从弱对齐的3D物体集合中生成近似的跨实例语义-几何监督。我们的目标不是恢复精确的点级对应关系，因为这类对应关系在不同实例之间往往存在歧义，且大规模获取需要昂贵且不切实际的人工监督。相反，我们自动生成语义上有意义、几何上一致、且足够多样化以用于训练现代对应关系模型的近似对应关系。仅需粗糙的类别级旋转对齐作为输入，SemGeo-Gen将多视角DINOv2特征提升到3D空间，使用连续分段仿射配准对齐物体实例，并利用语义一致性筛选候选匹配。所生成的3D对应关系可以投影到渲染视图中，从而无需人工标注即可获得可扩展的3D-3D、3D-2D和2D-2D监督。我们验证了所生成的对应关系……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: SemGeo-Gen提出了一种无监督方法，可从弱对齐的3D物体集合中自动生成语义有意义、几何一致的近似跨实例对应关系，无需人工标注即可提供可扩展的3D-3D、3D-2D和2D-2D监督信号。
